title: Nonminimizing Limits of Noisy Clarke Subgradient Descent

comparators.scope: 442 frozen literal contracts across the 36 production components, covering the source inventory and supporting statements.
Lemma 5.1 with an extra False premise.
Unchanged Lemma 5.1 type proved from a deliberately forbidden axiom.

main_results.scope: Almost-sure trapping and convergence of Clarke-subgradient iterates for a fixed oracle/noise pair satisfying the conditional absolute-continuity, support, initialization, tilt and power-step hypotheses.
A minimum Euclidean-norm measurable selection and deterministic initialization converge to a nonminimum with probability one under iid disk noise.
No conull tilt set satisfies the universal good-tilt predicate over all admissible algorithmic choices; a necessary canonical iid case is refuted.
Scaled selected iterates are trapped for every finite positive noise radius; the higher-dimensional extension uses full Euclidean-ball noise.
